name: @stripsearch/web
description: StripSearch authenticated web alpha: same-origin Express + Better Auth + SQLite + vanilla TypeScript client.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && node --import tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch src/server/index.ts
